You can also use it on web, and everything stays seamlessly synced across platforms. Just forward your chats, and Snowie helps you understand what’s really going on: emotional patterns, mixed signals, and the truth behind confusing conversations. It also tracks your relationship wellbeing over time—giving you a real-time view of where your relationship is heading.

records.name: Toodo - The shared couple to-do list
records.tagline: The to-do list built for two
records.description: Toodo is a shared to-do list built for two. Every task you complete together fills one half of a heart, and your partner's checks fill the other. No more forgotten errands, silent mental loads, or "I thought you were handling it." Toodo turns everyday tasks into tiny moments of teamwork, wrapped in a soft, pastel world that actually makes you want to open your to-do list. Built for roommates, partners, newlyweds, and anyone who just wants to buy groceries without a 14-message thread.

records.name: Pica
records.tagline: Fully native app for managing your fonts on MacOS
records.description: Organize into collections, test color themes and logos, watch folders, manage what's installed, and much more.

records.name: MemoHill
records.tagline: Create Anki Language Learning cards by chatting
records.description: No more endless hours manually creating Anki cards. Memohill automatically creates Anki flashcards for language learning. Set up your card structure and start chatting with AI. Each word you don't know will be explained in chat, and a flashcard for this word will be created.

records.name: roastmaster.ai
records.tagline: Feedback for your startup idea before to save your 6 months
records.description: RoastMaster is an AI that reads your startup idea and tells you — bluntly — why a real investor would pass on it in 30 seconds. No encouragement. No "great concept but consider..." No hedging. How it works: → Paste your startup idea (one paragraph is enough) → You get a brutality score, a full roast, and specific weak points → First roast is completely free → ₹49 per roast after that — cheaper than finding out from paying customers Built by XenithHQ — the AI feedback company.

records.name: Edgee Team
records.tagline: Strava for your coding assistants
records.description: Who on your team shipped more with less? Which repo is silently eating your AI budget? Edgee Teams gives coding assistants their missing dashboard. Invite your team, connect GitHub, and every session gets tracked, attributed, and ranked. Compare compression ratios across developers. Share session stats publicly or keep them private. Climb the monthly leaderboard and claim the title of biggest token spender. Built for teams shipping with Claude Code, Codex, and other agents.

records.name: CodeZero
records.tagline: The automation world gets to the next era with CodeZero.
records.description: Start with CodeZero to build scalable no-code automations. From logistics to custom chatbots, manage complex workflows with total data sovereignty.

records.name: Muggle Test
records.tagline: Paste a URL. See what your users actually experience
records.description: Paste a URL. Muggle Test walks through your web product like a real user — signup, navigation, error states, wrong inputs. Not just “does it work” but “does the experience work.” No code required. Results in under 10 minutes. Test scripts persist — replay them after every deploy to catch regressions, not just first-time bugs. Also: Muggle AI Works (MCP skill suite that adds automated QA to AI coding) and Muggle AI Teams (An agent workflow that we used when developing) Free tier. No credit card.

records.name: Repolog — Jobsite Photos to PDF
records.tagline: Snap jobsite photos → get a client-ready PDF. No cloud.
records.description: Every week, field teams hear the same request: “Please send a PDF report.” Then they lose hours at night dragging photos into Word. Repolog ends that busywork. Take site photos, add a caption to each, and tap once. Repolog creates a clean A4/Letter PDF with a cover page, notes, and photo pages—formatted the way reviewers expect. Built for contractors, inspectors, maintenance, cleaning, and patrol crews. Offline-first. No account. No cloud. From $2.99/mo.

records.name: Flex Assist
records.tagline: Amazon Flex
records.description: Amazon Flex onboarding for US drivers: waitlist bypass, Level 2 fast path, Fresh & Whole Foods access. The legal 2-week method 2,000+ drivers use.

records.name: Video to Image Sequence
records.tagline: Extract video frames free no upload, no limits, 100% private
records.description: Most video frame extractors upload your file to a server — we don't. Everything runs 100% in your browser. ✅ No file size limit ✅ No server upload — 100% private ✅ JPG or PNG output ✅ Custom FPS (1, 5, 10, 24, 30) ✅ Batch process multiple videos ✅ ZIP download all frames ✅ Works on any device — free forever Perfect for animators, game devs, VFX artists, and ML engineers.

records.name: Cohortly
records.tagline: AI-powered application review & scoring for programs
records.description: Cohortly is an AI-powered application review platform that helps accelerators, grant programs, fellowships, and universities evaluate and score applications faster, more fairly, and at scale using custom rubrics.

records.name: The Best Astro Website Templates
records.tagline: Multipage Astro templates for modern websites
records.description: Flux Theme builds Astro + React + Tailwind templates for developers and agencies. This review covers architecture, animations, SEO setup, and whether it's worth buying.

records.name: Refero Clone
records.tagline: Design research companion with AI search
records.description: 100,000+ curated real product screens for web & iOS, ready to search. User flows, pages, UX patterns, UI elements, fonts, and everything in between — all in one place. Built for people who build.

records.name: Sable
records.tagline: Write with intention. Create without distraction.
records.description: Sable is a beautiful, local-first writing app that keeps your words private, your focus sharp, and your creativity flowing.

records.name: Immigration Consultants in Bangalore
records.tagline: Croyez Immigration – Trusted Immigration Experts Bangalore
records.description: Looking for Immigration Consultants in Bangalore? Get trusted help with high success rate for eligibility, documents and filing. Book your free consultation today!

records.name: DocTools.CC — Free Document & Image Tool
records.tagline: Process, convert, and generate PDFs, images, and forms free
records.description: DocTools.CC provides 91+ free, browser-based tools to process, convert, compress, and generate documents and images. Handle PDF tasks like merge, split, sign, watermark, and OCR; convert DOCX, XLSX, JPG, HEIC, and HTML; and create US tax forms, invoices, NDAs, leases, and construction documents. No registration or watermarks. Sensitive files are processed locally in your browser, and any uploads auto-delete after 30 minutes

records.name: FinX – Privacy-First Finance Tracker
records.tagline: Budget tracker that works offline. Your data stays yours.
records.description: Most finance apps trade your data for convenience. FinX doesn't. It works 100% offline with zero account required — your data never leaves your device. Want sync? Self-host the backend and get Pro free, forever. The standout: GPS location reminders that detect when you leave a store and nudge you to log it, using hardware geofencing so it barely touches your battery. No ads, no tracking, no locked features.

records.name: ToolSnak
records.tagline: Free URL Encoder & Decoder — No Login, No Ads
records.description: ToolSnak offers 50+ free online tools — PDF editors, calculators, image tools, AI writers, QR code generators & more. No signup required. All tools run in your browser at toolsnak.com.

records.name: Typova
records.tagline: Free AI writing tools — no signup, no paywall
records.description: 3 free AI writing tools. No signup. No paywall. ✍️ Paragraph Rewriter — paste text, pick a tone, get it rewritten instantly. 📧 Email Reply Writer — paste a received email, pick your tone, get a reply ready to send. 👤 Bio Generator — enter your name and skills, get a professional bio for LinkedIn or Instagram. Most AI tools hide behind paywalls. Typova doesn't. Built with Next.js + Groq AI.

records.name: PDFGen AI
records.tagline: Beautiful PDFs with a API call AI-powered templates included
records.description: PDFGen AI is a developer-first PDF generation API. Send HTML or describe what you need in plain English — our AI creates professional templates, maps your data, and returns pixel-perfect PDFs in seconds.

records.name: IncidentLab
records.tagline: Train on real production incidents
records.description: Train on real production failures in a live terminal. Incidents sourced from the field: real systems, automatic validation.
